description: CALL THIS BEFORE reading source files. Returns a minimal editScope (3-10 files) with signatures from the pattern index instead of full file bodies. Uses semantic search when embeddings are available. If index is missing, instructs to call rigour_index first. Highest-impact token saver in the Rigour protocol.

agentId.description: Optional agent ID for context telemetry attribution.

cwd.description: Absolute path to the project root.

limit.description: Maximum number of pattern matches to return (default: 10).

query.description: Natural-language description of what you need to work on (e.g. 'add priority field to task service').

taskId.description: Optional task ID for context telemetry attribution.

name: rigour_context_scope
